summary: Tested FII/DII Activity feature with IST-aware date logic, availability status, source badges, NSE link, and refresh button. Backend: 25/25 tests pass. Current IST time is 18:32 (after 6 PM) on Friday July 24, 2026. API returns source='NSE F&O Archive' (live data), data_for_date='24-Jul-2026', availability.status='released'. Frontend: all UI elements working correctly - FII toggle opens section, data_for_date badge visible, refresh button present, source badge correct, live FII positions data shown.

minor.issue: Minor date label discrepancy: data_for_date='24-Jul-2026' (IST logic: after 6 PM = today) but actual archive data fetched is date='23-Jul-2026' (previous day). _fetch_fii_data_sync() uses _trading_days_back() which starts from yesterday, never tries today's date. Cosmetic only - user sees '24-Jul-2026' label but trend data starts from '23-Jul'. Not a blocking bug.

action_items: Optional: In _fetch_fii_data_sync(), consider also trying today's date (DDMMYYYY) when IST hour >= 18, before going to yesterday. This would make data_for_date and actual fetched date consistent. Currently data_for_date='24-Jul-2026' (IST logic) but archive data returns '23-Jul-2026' (yesterday's CSV).
critical_code_review_comments: data_for_date vs actual date mismatch: _last_trading_day_for_fii() returns '24-Jul-2026' after 6 PM, but _fetch_fii_data_sync() only tries yesterday and earlier (never today). When source='NSE F&O Archive', both data_for_date and the actual 'date' field display as '24-Jul-2026' in the UI header, but the trend shows 23-Jul as most recent. Very minor but could cause user confusion.
context_for_next_testing_agent: FII feature fully verified. API: source='NSE F&O Archive' (live data), data_for_date='24-Jul-2026', availability={status:'released', show_timer:false}. Frontend (news-btn opens Market Intelligence Panel): fii-section-toggle opens FII section, fii-refresh-btn visible when open, data_for_date='24-Jul-2026' badge in header, source badge='NSE F&O Archive'. Availability card (Released/Pending/Weekend badges) only shown when no live FII data (source='unavailable'). When source=unavailable (verified via first API call at start of testing), nse_url='https://www.nseindia.com/report-detail/fo_participant_vol' is present. Test file: /app/backend/tests/test_fii_feature.py (25 tests).
